title: Objectwise topological cohomology comparison
statement: Let f:Z -> X be continuous and assume its direct image on abelian sheaves is additive [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Let KX and KZ be the free abelian sheaves on the terminal representables, and let H_X^p and H_Z^p be the canonical Ext cohomology functors [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Let a:KX -> f_*KZ send every sheafification generator h:U -> X to the generator f^{-1}(h) followed by f^{-1}(X)=Z. For each degree p and each abelian sheaf F on Z there exists an additive homomorphism tau:H_X^p(f_*F) -> H_Z^p(F). For any injective resolutions I of F and J of f_*F, any comparison phi:J -> f_*I commuting with the augmentations in degree zero, and any degree-p cocycles s:KX -> J^p and z:KZ -> I^p with a composed with f_*z = s composed with phi^p, tau sends J.extMk(s) to I.extMk(z). No naturality in F is asserted.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemmas 13.18.6 and 13.18.7; with the cohomology definition of Tag 01DZ and terminal-section identity of the proof of Tag 01EZ

proof.text: Instantiate the existing topological Leray spectral-object augmentation theorem with HX and HZ equal to the canonical cohomology presheaf functors evaluated at the terminal opens. Their specified identifications hX and hZ are reflexive. Obtain its spectral object Y, first-quadrant proof hY, abutment isomorphisms h, interval isomorphisms e, and universal cocycle formula he. For the given p and F, take tau to be the component at F of the derived-zero transformation whiskered by HX p, followed by (e p 0).inv, the bottom edge of Y, and (h p).hom. This is an additive-group morphism by construction. Introduce arbitrary I, J, phi and the cocycles in the statement. Apply he to these data. Since hX and hZ are reflexive, their transports simplify to identities, giving exactly the required equality of Ext classes. No chosen resolution or additional hypothesis is used.
